name: Swagatam Trading & Services Li
summary: Swagtam Trading & Services Ltd. operates as a diversified trading enterprise, engaging in real estate, commission-based activities, and the acquisition and sale of both bullion and other commodities. The firm also offers services encompassing real estate project development, assistance for developers, expert consultancy, and various support functions. Established on December 31, 1984, the company's headquarters are located in New Delhi, India.
